answer: Vesting terraces make every fake key wait before it can cash out. Each reward pays into yarrow, a vesting ledger, in 3 terraces of one third, released 10, 20 and 30 epochs later; a key flagged by an audit forfeits every unreleased terrace. An auditor marks a suspect with an onyx, a public flag that freezes its terraces and pays the auditor 20% of the forfeit. A farm of 1,000 fakes earning 10 POA per epoch keeps up to 1,000 x 10 x 30 epochs = 300,000 POA frozen under one audit. Attacker pays 300,000 POA.
